review.tagline: Go and Vue 3 admin platform with RBAC and a CRUD code generator
review.summary: Full-stack admin framework with a Gin and GORM backend and a Vue 3 and Element Plus frontend. It ships JWT and Casbin permissions, dynamic menus and routes, a form builder and a code generator that produces basic CRUD for backend and frontend. The README also advertises an MCP integration for AI editors that drives code generation.
review.audience: Go and Vue developers building admin back offices for small projects
strengths: JWT plus Casbin role, menu and API permissions built in
Code generator produces backend and frontend CRUD from a template
Swagger docs via swag; Redis-backed multi-login limit
File upload to Qiniu, Aliyun and Tencent Cloud included
weaknesses: AI is limited to an MCP hook for code generation; no AI app features
No billing or tenancy described; some features need a paid license
No free technical support; paid support only
README is mainly in Chinese; no Docker setup detected
needs: Needs MySQL or MariaDB 5.7+, Redis, Go >= 1.22, Node > 18.16.0
